subject: Service delivery runbook + edge access checklist for Arden Health private deployment
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@ardenhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: deployment runbook & edge access for Arden Health private deploy

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is ready to move forward with the private deployment. Before we lock calendar windows for cutover, our network team asked for a vendor runbook and a concrete edge/access checklist so they can pre-approve firewall & peering work.

Could you share a runbook that includes: VPC peering requirements, required CIDRs, private endpoint IPs, egress rules, and any on-prem appliance install notes? Also, is there an 'edge access checklist' we can run against our change window?

We'd like to target a staging handoff the week of July 5. Please let me know what you need from our side.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Sr. IT Ops, Arden Health
samir@ardenhealth.com

Attachments: none
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@ardenhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: deployment runbook & edge access for Arden Health private deploy

Hi Samir — thanks, this is great to hear. I've attached a first-pass runbook and an edge access checklist (see attachments). They cover VPC peering flow, expected CIDR ranges, recommended NAT/egress options, and the on-prem appliance preflight list.

Short next steps from our side:
- We (Redwood) will do a 30-minute network scoping call with your network engineer to confirm CIDRs and routing.
- Laura (implementation lead) will draft a staging cutover plan and test matrix.
- Marcus (infra) will review the runbook for any hardware-specific notes for the on-prem package.

Can you share a contact for your network engineer and confirm a good day/time for a scoping call this week? If July 5 staging is still in play, we should lock the call latest by 6/18.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-onprem-runbook-v0.1.pdf, edge-access-checklist.xlsx

Looping you both in — Arden Health is ready to schedule network scoping and wants the runbook/checklist we shared. High level asks from their team: VPC peering requirements, CIDRs, private endpoints, egress & firewall rules, and on-prem appliance notes.

Could you confirm owners and provide updates by EOD tomorrow? I'm proposing a scoping call with Arden on Thu 6/17 at 10:00am PT — does that work?

Thanks — Naomi

-- Forwarded message attached below --
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samir Rao <samir@ardenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service delivery runbook + edge access checklist for Arden Health private deployment

Hi all — quick technical notes and a few asks ahead of the scoping call. Attached a short 'network-questions.md' I'll use to walk through the environment.

Key items for Arden to confirm before the call:
1) CIDR blocks you plan to use for the VPC peering (public/private subnets) and whether overlap exists with Redwood's staging ranges.
2) Do you require inbound connections to the on-prem appliance or will traffic be strictly outbound to our private endpoints? If inbound is needed, list allowed source IPs.
3) Egress policy: do you block egress to non-approved destinations? If so, we'll provide IPs/FQDNs for the runtime telemetry and artifact checkout endpoints.
4) TLS termination: will you terminate TLS on your side or pass-through to Redwood? We prefer mutual TLS for provable identity — we'll provide cert generation steps if you want mTLS.

Notes on the on-prem package: 4 vCPU, 16GB RAM baseline for small workloads; NVMe recommended for caches. Appliance binds to a static management IP; we'll need one reserved IP for the appliance and 1-2 IPs for private endpoints depending on HA.

I'll be on the 6/17 call — Marcus
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: network-questions.md

Thanks Naomi and team — apologies for the delayed reply, been heads-down on a change freeze. Answers below and next steps:

1) CIDRs: Attached is a CSV with the three subnets we can dedicate: 10.48.0.0/24, 10.48.1.0/24, 10.48.2.0/24. No overlap with Redwood staging ranges. (See attachment: arden-network-cidrs.csv)
2) Inbound: We'll allow inbound only to the management plane IPs you specify from our peered VPC — otherwise traffic is outbound to private endpoints.
3) Egress: We do restrict egress; please provide a short list of FQDNs/IPs required for runtime telemetry, artifact pulls, and package updates.
4) TLS: We can support mutual TLS. I'll loop in our network lead, ops@ardenhealth.com, to work mTLS cert exchange.

Network contact: Priya Nambiar (priya.nambiar@ardenhealth.com, +1-415-555-0118). She can join the call on Thu 6/17 at 10:00am PT.

Also: I'll sign the mutual NDA via DocuSign this afternoon (link below). Looking forward to the scoping call.

Thanks — Samir
